text:
maria_g: quick sync — ACME pilot asks: bump trial cap to 100k tokens/day, include embeddings, and waive embedding unit fee for 30 days. They want to start next week. do we have bandwidth to scope this into the sprint?

 tom_s: sales says it's the only way ACME will sign the POC. they need embeddings for search demo.

 jess_p: 100k tokens/day for a pilot seems high from a cost POV — what's the expected usage profile? bursty or steady? :thinking:

 tom_s: mostly steady for demo users, plus a couple heavy eval scripts. they estimated ~700k tokens over 7 days.

 kai_r: technically trivial to raise a per-account cap, but embedding waiver affects billing pipeline + rate limits. we'll need a fast guardrail to avoid accidental overuse.

 alex_sales: proposal: "trial cap = 25k tokens/day + 100k embedding units credit for 30d" — keeps token exposure lower but gives them embedding runway. also offer a short-lived quota boost if they sign LOI.

 jess_p: that split seems reasonable. run the unit economics: if they actually use all 100k embedding units at current cost, what's our gross loss? we should set a top-level hard cap.

 maria_g: draft launch criteria we need before enabling: 1) acceptance test for demo 2) SLA doc for pilot 3) guardrail in billing to auto-disable after cap hit 4) sign LOI or PO on file. can eng own 3?

 kai_r: we can ship a temporary guardrail by Wed: simple middleware check that rejects requests once a trial flag consumes credits. config example: 
```json
{"trial_policy": {"token_cap_per_day": 25000, "embedding_credit": 100000, "auto_disable_on_exhaust": true}}
```
No changes to core runtime.

 legal_bot: note — waive-fees for 30d needs a short addendum. include clause: "waived fees limited to pilot account id, non-transferable, expires after 30 days". I can draft.

 jess_p: if we proceed with 25k + 100k embed credit, finance approves under the condition we log consumption daily and cap cumulative pledge at X (I put X = $2,000 for now).

 maria_g: action items: kai to prototype guardrail (ETA Wed), legal to prep addendum (ETA EOD Tue), sales to get LOI draft, finance to confirm pledge ceiling. if all green, we'll toggle trial flag for ACME next Fri. :thumbsup:
